why: Both prescribe nearly the same focused in-state ARM hedgehog and stop-doing list, but Analysis 2 makes the unfocused diversification the most urgent brutal fact and names the specific deregulated lines to refuse, which is closest to the key's 'no coherent hedgehog' finding. Analysis 1 is better calibrated (explicit confidence, the MBS-swap caveat, fewer unsupported claims) and alone flags the single-state concentration that later hurt the company, but its headline puts rate mismatch ahead of the diversification drift.
